projects.title: For Youth & Children
projects.description:
We got selected in three separate occasions by UNICEF in Kosovo to produce a variety of materials covering various issues regarding children during the COVID-19 pandemic.

To Be a Child in Kosovo

We produced three videos about findings from Multiple Cluster Survey (MICS), with distinctive artistic illustrations we have animated the data that show what it means to be a child in Kosovo (data on situation of children and families in Kosovo), early education (how well the children in Kosovo develop), and functionality of children in Kosovo (data on children’s functional difficulties in different…

data.content: We got selected in three separate occasions by UNICEF in Kosovo to produce a variety of materials covering various issues regarding children during the COVID-19 pandemic. To Be a Child in Kosovo We produced three videos about findings from Multiple Cluster Survey (MICS), with distinctive artistic illustrations we have animated the data that show what it means to be a child in Kosovo (data on situation of children and families in Kosovo), early education (how well the children in Kosovo develop), and functionality of children in Kosovo (data on children’s functional difficulties in different areas).  https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fnp-NnuaMck https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lO3Hr58SA7A https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l5lXeUXi5-A 51 videos digitalising PONDER, UPSHIFT and PODIUM Project Initiatives With the progress of COVID-19 pandemic, UNICEF Kosovo entrusted us to produce 51 videos with the aim to digitalise tutorials of non-formal education from PONDER, UPSHIFT and PODIUM initiatives for adolescent and young people that were unable to attend physically these trainings. Produced in Albanian and Serbian languages, below are four examples out of 51 videos in total. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BUmaHgfqZEM https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RjcUzud-96s https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c1rYVauD88Y https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iWCK9DJx_5Y Preventing COVID-19 | Easy 2 Make it Work
UNICEF Kosovo also entrusted us to create five videos promoting COVID-19 prevention response measure to children, young people and families.
Each video treats a topic, promoting hygiene, wearing masks and keeping the social distance. The videos were broadcasted across all national TV stations.
